item.title: Signing in to the patient portal
item.body: If you cannot sign in, open the [portal sign-in page](https://portal.synthetic-health.test/sign-in) and choose Forgot password. Account recovery always happens inside the portal's own recovery process. The support assistant never asks for your password or a one-time code and cannot reset credentials. If recovery does not work, you can ask for a person and a support specialist will help through the identity team's process.
